result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a signalized intersection with sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The presence of multiple utility poles at the corner and a commercial driveway creates potential physical and visual obstructions for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: Multiple utility poles located at the corner narrow the effective sidewalk width and may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance, improve sightlines, and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing exposure to high-volume traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Vehicle Encroachment
hazards.description: A vehicle is positioned partially within the intersection area, which can obstruct the pedestrian path or sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance for pedestrians. The sidewalk on the left is narrow and partially obstructed by utility poles, which may impede accessibility.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the narrow sidewalk path, creating obstacles for people with mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk on the left side of the image.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and relocate utility poles to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway lacks physical traffic calming or refuge islands, resulting in significant exposure for pedestrians during the crossing.
